title: [v6.2] tmt: disable podman-next on release-branch PRs
body:
Testing Farm enables the podman-next COPR for every PR, and update-deps.sh then upgrades the guest from it. That COPR is built from main, so a release-branch PR would be tested against main's stack. Leave the repo enabled only when PACKIT_TARGET_BRANCH is main.

comments.body: FYI please use `git cherry-pick -x` to actually mention the commit on main so reviewers can validate it properly. And when you target a different branch please include the name in the PR title and then ideally wait for the main PR to be merged first as we must make sure main is always merged first and there may be more review comment there.
